values: PERMIT ACTION: Proposed revocation and reissuance of the current permit (effective June 1, 2016; expiration May 31, 2021)
Whether this draft permitting action is the governing permit instrument during FY2025 or only a proposed replacement for an expired permit

grounding.excerpt:
FOR THE DRAFT NATIONAL POLLUTANT DISCHARGE ELIMINATION SYSTEM
(NPDES) PERMIT TO DISCHARGE TO WATERS OF THE UNITED STATES

DATE PREPARED

March 15, 2021

PERMIT ACTION

Proposed revocation and reissuance of the current permit issued with an effective date of June 1,
2016, and an expiration date of May 31, 2021.

rationale: The packet positively establishes that the source document is a DRAFT NPDES permit fact sheet (March 15, 2021) describing a proposed revocation and reissuance of a permit expiring May 31, 2021. However, it does not include any effluent limits, monitoring requirements, or other permit conditions whose enforceability must be judged; it does not mention the Federal FY2025 evaluation period; and it provides no record of permit finalization, administrative continuation, or which instrument (if any) governs during FY2025. The packet itself flags that auto-assembly may leave it evidence-insufficient. Although DRAFT and Proposed characterize the permitting action, that alone does not ground whether associated limits and monitoring requirements are proposed rather than enforceable governing obligations for the specified evaluation period, nor whether this action is the governing instrument during FY2025 versus only a proposed replacement. Per P5, unsupported uncertainty is preferred to unsupported semantic closure; neither ACCEPT nor REJECT is sufficiently grounded.
